messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — NimbusCorp says the enterprise promo from their PO (PO# NC-1423) didn't apply; invoice shows full charge. Sales added PO note 'Q4_PARTNER_20' and contract appendix A references the promo. Ticket #Z-5012. Need manual credit grant + ledger fix before EOD if possible.

sam_sales: I added the PO note but looks like our promo matcher didn't pick it up — note uses underscore vs our matcher expecting a hyphen (`Q4_PARTNER_20` vs `Q4-PARTNER-20`). I can confirm contract text matches the promo code semantics.

alex_finance: We'll need copy of PO + signed contract in the ticket to authorize manual adjustment. Also need account owner's written approval. How much is the credit?

maria_cs: Customer invoice shows $18,000 for Oct. Promo should be 20% on subscription line (SKU: INF-DED-1yr) => $3,600. Please apply $3,600 credit to ledger L-9987 and update invoice INV-2026-10.

jules_support: Repro steps: `GET /ledger/transactions?po=NC-1423` returns the charge but no promo tag. Matcher regex currently expects `Q4-PARTNER-20`. Quick options: reload matcher rules then re-evaluate, or do manual ledger adjust.

sam_sales: @alex_finance attached PO & e-signed contract to Z-5012 — legal confirmed verbally.

alex_finance: Acknowledged. Preparing manual adjustment. Snippet (internal):
```
POST /internal/ledger/adjust
{
  "ledger_id":"L-9987",
  "amount":-3600,
  "reason":"Enterprise PO promo Q4_PARTNER_20 manual grant",
  "reference":"NC-1423 / INV-2026-10"
}
```
I'll wait for end-of-day accounting window (2h) then execute.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Please CC customer when done so they see updated invoice.

billing-bot: Automated: manual adjustment queued by alex_finance — job 78621. ETA ~45m. Logs: https://logs.redwood.dev/job/78621

sam_sales: :eyes: pinging @legal to confirm no contract amendment required.

alex_finance: Job 78621 completed; ledger L-9987 adjusted and INV-2026-10 updated with -$3,600 credit. Customer was notified via support email.

maria_cs: :tada: NimbusCorp confirmed receipt and invoice shows the credit. Filing note in docs: docs/customer-credits/NimbusCorp-Q4-2026.md :memo:

jules_support: I'll open PR to relax the matcher to accept both `Q4_PARTNER_20` and `Q4-PARTNER-20` to avoid recurrence. PR #4523.

sam_sales: Thanks everyone — closing the loop on this ticket.
